title: Chapter 1480
text:
Han Xiao teleported back to the office on the main planet of the Supers Holy Land. The meeting with the heads of the three Universal Civilizations was much faster than expected, but Ames did not wait there. She had already left, and the room was empty.

"Where did she go?"

"Her Excellency Ames went to look for Aurora, hum … Do you want me to inform her to come over?"

"No need. I'll take the initiative to look for her later."

Han Xiao casually asked and did not ask further. His expression was not as relaxed as when he was talking to the heads of the three Universal Civilizations. Instead, he had a lot on his mind.

He told the heads of the three Universal Civilizations that he was worried that the stable interference bridge would be damaged during the transformation. This was not a lie but a real worry.

After this period of testing, he realized that as a medium for the transformation, when he officially activated the Information Materialization device, he would suffer a large amount of information impact and temporarily establish a connection with the consciousness of the universe. During the reverse transformation to the True State, the interface, as a special product of the dark side universe, would gradually lose its effect. Therefore, the Character Summon Card could not continue to function during the transformation process.

If he wanted to maintain his consciousness and maintain the effect of (Virtual Creation.True), he would have to strengthen his information foundation and add some 'Information Anchor Points' to prevent himself from being unable to hold on and causing the Information Interference Channel to be disconnected.

He did not reveal these details, and no one could help him. It would only add to his troubles.

"The so-called Information Anchor Points should be my understanding of myself, my connection with the World Tree, and my past memories …"

Han Xiao pondered.

This was a rather mysterious perception. If he had not reached the Transcendent Grade, he would not have had such an intuition. Tracing back the past and remembering the past might be a way to deepen the Information Anchor Points.

"The three Universal Civilizations are about to start preparing. I have to prepare too …"

Han Xiaoxin calmed down, changed into another set of King, and disappeared from the room again.

…

Shattered Star Ring, Blue Star.

The planet that had been abandoned for more than ten years regained its prosperity after the people of Blue Star moved back. The old buildings that were covered by nature were demolished and rebuilt, and the entire planet was almost brand new.

There was only one place that had not been renovated. The huge ruins had been covered by wild green vegetation, and the large number of building debris on the ground had rusted away. This was the ruins of the Germinal Organization. It lay quietly on the wasteland, silent as always. Only the traces left behind by time seemed to tell the story of the past.

The three figures slowly walked around the ruins, stopping and observing from time to time.

"… Back then, your godfather and I fought side by side and destroyed the Germinal Organization. He snuck in alone and stole a lot of confidential information. He even rescued the young Hella and Aurora. He fought for thousands of miles before he finally got the information. In the end, the war was decided and the Six Nations had nothing to worry about. They used a nuclear explosion to destroy the Germinal Organization … and Blue Star was reborn that day."

Bennett caressed the remains of a huge metal plate. He wiped away the rust on it with his palm, revealing a blurry Germinal Organization imprint. His eyes could not help but reveal a complicated look of reminiscence, as if he was reminiscing about the era of war.

Nero, who was standing behind him, took a few steps forward and placed his hand on the metal plate as well. "I've seen these stories in textbooks, but every time I come to the ruins of the Germinal Organization, I always feel like I'm there. It's as if I've experienced a battle that changed the fate of this planet."

Bennett turned to look at him, shook his head, and laughed. "Thinking about it, Black Star was like a completely different person compared to him now … Sigh, when people get old, they love to reminisce about the past."

"You're not old yet," Mia, who was carrying a child, said with a smile.

Bennett laughed heartily. He walked in front of Mia and bent down to look at the baby in Mia's arms. The baby was looking at him curiously with his big eyes. He chuckled and stretched out his two short hands.

"Yo, my good grandson, let Grandpa carry you."

Bennett's face was full of kindness, and his arms that could easily crush steel carefully received his grandson. He held him in his arms and shook him gently.

Nero also came over with a face full of envy.

Although he was the father of the child, the child would cry non-stop whenever he hugged him. On the other hand, his son could only sleep peacefully in the arms of his grandfather, Bennett.

After the war ended, Nero and Mia made a baby, which made Bennett very happy.

Considering that Nero had become the acting Army Commander and that the Blue Star Federation was on the right track, Bennett thought about it and chose to step down from his position as the leader of the Blue Star Federation. Originally, many of the upper echelons did not agree and hoped that Bennett would be re-elected. However, he had already made up his mind and was determined to step down. Now, he was no longer in charge of any position and was retiring to enjoy the happiness of his family.

Bennett played with the baby for a while before looking at Nero and asking, "Have you tested his Super genes?"

"Yes, the report says that his Super genes are extremely active, and it's rare. He might be an extremely talented Esper in the future." Nero was overjoyed.

"Is that so? That's not bad either." Bennett nodded and stroked the baby's sparse hair.

The three of them played with the baby and chatted happily as they slowly walked away.

Suddenly, the space rippled, and Han Xiao's figure walked out. He stood on the spot and watched as Bennett and his grandchildren left happily.

"How beautiful …"

He then turned to look at the Germinal Organization ruins in front of him. Reminiscence appeared in his eyes as well.

He had already walked a very long path, but when he looked back, his past on this planet seemed to be right in front of him, as if it was just yesterday.

The memories that had been sealed away surged like a tide, and scenes flashed before his eyes one after another. The half a year of darkness he had spent in the Germinal Organization's base after transmigrating to this world, driving an off-road vehicle under the moonlight after escaping with much difficulty, leaving Stardragon and transforming into Black Phantom to walk alone in the wasteland, infiltrating the Germinal Organization to steal information and being hunted down for thousands of miles, turning the Germinal Organization headquarters into Ashes in a dazzling nuclear explosion …

Similarly, the figures of people flashed before his eyes one after another. The young Hella who was determined to jump into the abyss but was eventually pulled back by him, the young Aurora who was still optimistic despite being tortured, the young Bennett who worked tirelessly to end the war, the Germinal Organization leader who was at the end of the road but did not turn back …

The tragedy of the subsequent Mutation Disaster also appeared before his eyes. The chaotic world, the crazy people, the endless beast hordes, the spaceships that fell from the sky, the blazing and fierce ship cannons … the source of everything was the Dark-star and finally the Dark-star.

"Two full versions of the disaster. This place is really full of misfortune and misfortune …"

Han Xiao closed his eyes slightly as the version of the plot flowed through his mind.

After a long time, he opened his eyes and felt that his mind was calm. There seemed to be some subtle changes in his body.

Somehow, his information foundation seemed to have become stronger, and he seemed to have set the first information anchor point to connect to Blue Star.

"Blue Star …"

Han Xiao slowly rose into the sky, looked down at the Germinal Organization ruins, and then looked at the bustling city at the end of the horizon. He gently turned around and disappeared without a trace.
